sections.heading: Pusarla Venkata Sindhu — Career and Professional Work
paras: Pusarla Venkata Sindhu works primarily as a badminton player and Olympic competitor.

She has taken part in badminton at the 2014 Asian Games – women's team, badminton at the 2016 Summer Olympics – women's singles, 2011 Dutch Open Badminton Championships – women's singles, 2015 Denmark Open Badminton Championships – women's singles and 2013 Badminton World Championships – women's singles.
